mapper.select: SELECT 'scm.merge.salesOrder' AS label_key, COUNT(*) AS total, 0 AS conflicts FROM scm_order WHERE kind = 'SALES' AND partner_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.salesTradeDoc', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_trade_doc WHERE kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND partner_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.tradeDraft', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_trade_draft WHERE kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND partner_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.shipment', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_shipment WHERE customer_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.priceList', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_price_list WHERE customer_id IN

SELECT 'scm.merge.purchaseOrder' AS label_key, COUNT(*) AS total, 0 AS conflicts FROM scm_order WHERE kind = 'PURCHASE' AND partner_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.purchaseTradeDoc', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_trade_doc WHERE kind IN ('PURCHASE_IN', 'PURCHASE_RETURN') AND partner_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.tradeDraft', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_trade_draft WHERE kind IN ('PURCHASE_IN', 'PURCHASE_RETURN') AND partner_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.carrier', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_trade_doc WHERE carrier_supplier_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.carrier', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_trade_draft WHERE carrier_supplier_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.carrier', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_shipment WHERE carrier_supplier_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.supplierEval', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_supplier_eval WHERE supplier_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.purchaseContract', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_purchase_contract WHERE supplier_id IN
